title: Young Women Horseback Riding in Field, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot featuring two young women sitting atop dark horses in an outdoor riding paddock or training field under bright sunlight. In the distant background, a third rider and horse can be seen, alongside utility poles and a high-voltage electrical transmission tower against a clear sky. The photo has deckled/scalloped edges characteristic of mid-century commercial film processing.
